mapper.select:
select distinct i.TITLE from ALARM_INFO i left join asset a on i.asset_id = a.id where 1 = 1
and a.ASSET_SUPPLIER != 'JCCA'

select c.TYPE as orgType, c.TITLE as orgName, a.id as alarmId, a.TYPE as alarmType, a.TITLE, a.ALARM_LEVEL as alarmLevel, a.content, a.description, a.ALARM_CODE as alarmCode, a.OCCUR_TIME as occurTime, a.CONFIRM_TIME as confirmTime, a.confirmor as confirmor, a.ALARM_TO_RECORD as alarmToRecord, a.opinion, a.remark, a.blank, a.status, a.ALARM_STATE as alarmState from ALARM_INFO a join SYS_ORG c on a.ORG_ID = c.ID where a.blank = 1 and c.type = 2 and a.event_category = #{eventCategory} and a.STATUS = 1 and a.ALARM_STATE = 1 order by a.OCCUR_TIME desc

SELECT i.TITLE, i.ID, i.ALARM_TO_RECORD, i.OCCUR_TIME occurTimeStr, i.TYPE typeStr, i.CONTENT, i.DESCRIPTION, i.OPINION opinion, i.REMARK, i.ALARM_LEVEL, i.STATUS, i.BLANK, i.ALARM_CODE, a.ID assetId, a.NAME assetName, a.ORG_ID orgId, a.IP, a.ASSET_MODE assetMode, a.ASSET_IMAGE assetImage, t.NAME cabinetName, r.NAME roomName FROM ALARM_INFO i LEFT JOIN ASSET a ON i.ASSET_ID = a.ID LEFT JOIN ASSET_ATTACH c ON a.ID = c.ASSET_ID LEFT JOIN CABINET t ON t.ID = c.CABINET_ID LEFT JOIN ROOM r ON r.ID = c.ROOM_ID WHERE i.id = #{id}

select
from alarm_info i where i.asset_id = #{assetId} and i.alarm_code = #{alarmCode} and (i.status = 1 or (i.status = 2 and i.alarm_state = 1))

select i.id, i.title, i.alarm_level, i.content, i.occur_time, i.type, i.status, i.blank, i.alarm_state, i.IS_SHOW_RECOVER from alarm_info i where i.blank = 1 and i.asset_id = #{assetId} and (i.status = 1 or (i.status = 2 and i.alarm_state = 1))
order by i.occur_time desc

select i.id, i.title, i.alarm_level, i.content, i.occur_time, i.type, i.status, i.blank, i.alarm_state, i.IS_SHOW_RECOVER from alarm_info i where i.blank = 1 and i.asset_id = #{assetId} and (i.status = 1 or (i.status = 2 and i.alarm_state = 1)) and i.DESCRIPTION like '业务告警%' order by i.occur_time desc

select i.id, i.title, i.alarm_level, i.occur_time, i.type, i.status, i.alarm_state, i.org_id, i.asset_id, i.asset_name, i.CREATE_TIME from alarm_info i where i.blank = 1 and i.alarm_level in (
1,
2,
3,
0)
and i.STATUS = 1
and i.ALARM_STATE = 1
order by i.occur_time desc
SELECT * from (SELECT * FROM ALARM_INFO a WHERE a.ASSET_ID = ${assetId} ORDER BY a.OCCUR_TIME DESC, id) t WHERE ROWNUM = 1

select min(ALARM_LEVEL) FROM ALARM_INFO WHERE (ALARM_STATE = 1 OR STATUS = 1) AND BLANK = 1 AND ORG_ID IN
#{id}
